dataset_name: PennFudanPed Database + FireNET & Wildfire Smoke Subsets
license: Academic and Research Use (PennFudan) / MIT & CC (FireNET)
split_strategy: 70% Train, 15% Validation, 15% Test partitioned deterministically by image ID
notes: Ground truth labels reflect pedestrian presence, multi-person activity, and fire/smoke visuals. PERSON_ON_GROUND and FALL_LIKE_POSTURE are honestly documented as 0 samples in this upright pedestrian set. Vision model produces visual evidence only; a single frame NEVER declares an active emergency directly.
